defects_found.effect: the $1 price floor is tested against the first ADD message of the day, which for 762 symbols is a pre-open stub order priced at about one cent; those symbols are excluded even when their traded price is far above $1. On this tape the guard removed 5 of 120 intended scope symbols.
defects_found.impact_on_prior_evidence: M2-0 reported no symbol lost to the price floor in its own 61-symbol add-count scope, so no M2-0 number changes; the defect only mislabelled the eligibility of names outside that scope.
defects_found.correct_instrument: a price statistic (M2/src/universe_proxy.py uses the day's trade-price median, which is what the frozen rule's relative-tick-size variable implies)
defects_found.status: REPORTED_NOT_REPAIRED (repair would invalidate the frozen run; the loss is recorded instead)

defects_found.location: methodology note, not a code defect
defects_found.observation: the Nasdaq-only reconstructed book's touch is not the NBBO: 82 of 115 top-dollar-volume names have a median Nasdaq book spread above one tick (FB 2 ticks, NVDA 4 ticks, ...), so the frozen rule's one-tick large-tick screen selects 33 of the 115 largest names on this day.
defects_found.impact: this is a property of the candidate's own one-venue design and of the frozen universe rule, not an error; it is recorded because it bounds how many rule-conformant names exist
